## Recurring errors not named in the sheet

The recorded changes fit the ten supplied error categories; no additional recurring reading-error category is identified in the per-page records. One recurring comparison issue needs separate treatment: witness H gives editorial synopses of the main memoir on scans 021, 023, 025, 027, 029, 031, 033 and 034, while quoting selected annotations. The resulting main-text omission rows measure coverage and editorial policy as well as reading differences. They should not be used as a comparative error-rate estimate. The hand log records the recurring letter forms, abbreviated words, attached marks and partial underlines that affected actual readings.
